parser_notes: Synthetic but industrially-plausible tank/agitator/transfer-pump system authored to exercise features the real test corpus lacks. Contains a user-defined Valve_UDT and Motor_UDT, a MotorStarter Add-On Instruction definition plus an instance call, an alias tag (Start_PB -> HMI_Start), branched START/STOP seal-in interlocks with E-stop/permissive gating, TON/ONS/CTU instructions, UDT member references used as both BOOL and TIMER operands, an SQO step sequencer, and two Tasks/Programs (continuous ladder + periodic structured text). The current Rockwell connector only walks Programs/Program/Routines, so the AOI definition body, UDT definitions, alias targets, and Task scheduling are intentionally NOT resolved by the parser: the AOI instance call (MotorStarter) and the SQO sequencer surface as unknown opcodes, and UDT/alias tags are captured as flat tag references. These are the precise gaps Phase 2 (AOI/UDT resolution) and later phases must close; the fixture is the regression target for that work.
